name: comparison-split
title: Comparison split
description: Two columns side by side, each a title and a JSON list of points: a centre divider draws down, the titles slide in from their sides, a "vs" badge pops on the divider, and the points stagger in, left column first; held, then faded out. The right column carries the accent, for the option you favour. Transparent, with light text for dark backgrounds; set Ink to a dark colour for bright ones.

variables.label: Left points (JSON list)
variables.default: ["Opus for a typo fix","Pays full price per task","Same effort every turn"]

variables.label: Right points (JSON list)
variables.default: ["Haiku for the small stuff","A third of the cost per task","Escalates when a check fails"]
